selection_rationale: Live desks most likely met in French schools, theatres and rental fleets (Yamaha QL1/CL5/TF5/DM7, Allen & Heath SQ-6/Avantis, Behringer X32) plus the touring flagships that teach the main digital transports (DiGiCo SD12 = MADI/Optocore, Avid S6L = AVB, Yamaha RIVAGE PM10 = TWINLANe fibre + Dante). Broadcast/radio covers the three AoIP families (Axia iQ = Livewire+/AES67, Lawo ruby and DHD RX2 = AES67/RAVENNA/ST2110 + Dante) and Calrec Brio for TV. Avid S6 represents the post-production mix-stage console; Avid S1, SSL UF8 and Mackie MCU Pro cover DAW control surfaces and the EUCON / HUI / MCU protocols.

devices.technology: Modular radio/TV mixing surface (central module 52-5810 + fader modules 52-5820) with 10.1-inch touch displays, controlled over Ethernet by a 1U XC3 or XD3 DSP core; cores support Dante or AES67/RAVENNA/ST2110, plus MADI, analog, digital and GPIO I/O modules on CAT cabling.
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: DHD calls the RX2 its most flexible Series 52 surface for on-air radio, master control rooms and OB vans; DHD consoles are common in German and European radio, and the product news on DHD's site cites RX2 deployments for remote sports coverage.

key_specs.faders: 6 to 60 faders — modular and scalable (web page); up to 96 faders (flyer); professional-grade 100mm motorized faders with dust-protection
key_specs.displays: 10.1″ touch displays on every section; 7 inch vertical touch display in the central section
key_specs.central_module_io: A microphone input and a headphones output are included, and you can also connect your loudspeakers directly
key_specs.dsp_core: compact low-power 1 U module … XC3 or XD3; audio matrix of up to 10240 x 12288 with up to 96 fully processed stereo faders
key_specs.aoip: Dante or AES67/RAVENNA/ST2110; XC3 AES67 RAVENNA IPx module (52-7567) up to 128×128 channels; Dante IPx module (52-7585) up to 512 inputs and 512 outputs … two Gigabit Ethernet ports for glitch-free redundancy
key_specs.io_modules: separate XLR-I/O modules with half-rack width and 1 U height … connect … using CAT 5/6 cables; modules for analogue and digital audio, MADI and GPIO
key_specs.apc: standard CAT cables are used, carrying Audio, Power and Control signals in the same cable – DHD's APC technology
key_specs.control_interfaces: Ember+ via Ethernet, a serial connection or GPIO
key_specs.core_psu_options: 52-7496A XC Power Supply 48V / 250W; 52-7498B XC Power Supply 48V / 150W

Dante IPx module: two Gigabit Ethernet ports (redundant)

devices.technology: Flagship modular live system: CS-R10 control surface + DSP-RX/DSP-RX-EX engine with HY slots (TWINLANe optical, Dante, MADI cards) and MY slots; I/O via RPio racks (TWINLANe) or Rio (Dante); SILK processing.
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: RIVAGE PM10 is Yamaha's top-tier touring/theatre console line, whose interface the DM7 later inherited; its TWINLANe optical network carries up to 400 channels per ring.

devices.technology: Compact 48 kHz digital mixer with 32 XLR/TRS combo mic/line inputs, 16 XLR outputs, one expansion slot (e.g. Dante card) and a 34x34 USB audio interface.
devices.why_it_is_a_classic: The TF series is Yamaha's entry-level 'TouchFlow' digital mixer family; the TF5 (32+1 faders) is a frequent desk in schools, small venues and rental, and is easy to pair with Yamaha Tio/Rio stage boxes via an expansion card.

devices.why_it_is_a_classic: Allen & Heath markets Avantis as bringing its flagship dLive processing into a self-contained mid-size console; it is widely used by rental companies already stocking A&H stage boxes.
